name: a write above the cursor adjusts the count
a clear above the cursor adjusts the count
a slice persists its cursor outside its transaction
replace:
/\ cursor' = IF ended THEN cursor ELSE last
          /\ done' = ended
          /\ UNCHANGED <<walker, upTo>>

/\ upTo' = IF ended THEN cursor ELSE last
          /\ walker' = "cursor"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<cursor, done>>

name: an open trusts the status it had before the crash
replace:
/\ up' = TRUE
    /\ status' = n
    /\ up' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED status

name: a write past the end goes uncounted
the walk counts past its end
replace: LET past == {k \in queue : k > c /\ k < end}
